metadata.title: Engineering Mechanics and Wind Load Verification for Portable Hydraulic Street Light Pole Lifters: Safe Erection Envelope Under 300 kg Rated Capacity and 12 m Pole Classes
metadata.description: Comprehensive engineering mechanics formulation, statics equilibrium equations, dynamic wind sail area thresholds, and anchor stud pullout safety factors for the velolev Portable Hydraulic Light Pole Lifter (85 kg split two-module architecture, 24V battery power, 300 kg rated load, 12 m maximum column class, M16-M24 anchor bolt compatibility). Formulates an evidence-based operational envelope for crane-free municipal EPC lighting installations in space-constrained urban and off-grid environments.
